themes.name: Unreliable Size & Fit Info
themes.definition: Shoppers encounter contradictory or missing size charts, brand‑specific measurements, and vague fit descriptors that make it unclear whether the saved apparel will fit them. This uncertainty leads them to postpone or abandon the purchase.
includes: size chart numbers differ between product page and model details
no measurements for sleeves, inseam, or length
fit described as "relaxed" vs "true to size" without clarification
brand‑specific sizing that shoppers cannot map to their own size
excludes: general complaints about clothing style
issues with returns or refunds after purchase

themes.name: Misleading Visual Media
themes.definition: Product photos or videos are edited, taken from a single angle, use AI‑generated models, or have lighting that distorts colour, texture, and drape, so shoppers cannot trust the item will look as expected. This visual doubt blocks conversion from wishlist to cart.
includes: colour appears different in real life vs image
fabric texture looks smooth in photo but feels rough
single‑angle shots hide garment length or cut
AI‑rendered model that does not reflect true body shape
excludes: low‑resolution images that load slowly but are accurate
lack of any images (handled by missing specs theme)

themes.name: Quality, Authenticity & Seller Trust
themes.definition: Shoppers doubt that what arrives will be genuine and as described — fearing counterfeit branding, inferior material or stitching, previously returned goods, or listings they read as outright dishonest. This suspicion about the item and the seller behind it stops the purchase.
includes: concern that item is counterfeit or from dubious drop‑shipping source
reviews mentioning thin fabric, loose stitching, or cheap material
absence of brand‑level quality guarantees
mentions of possible used or refurbished goods
reports of counterfeit products on the site
claims that prices are artificially inflated then reduced
mentions of “scam sellers” or “fake reviews”
fear that the platform will cancel orders without reason
excludes: price-related complaints about value for money (see price-volatile-hidden-fees)
return-policy concerns unrelated to trust (see return-exchange-policy-friction)

themes.name: Cumbersome Return & Exchange Policies
themes.definition: The platform’s return or exchange flow is multi‑step, fee‑laden, or restrictive (e.g., non‑returnable tags, mandatory pickup OTP, high restocking fees), making shoppers fear they will be stuck with an unsatisfactory item. This perceived risk deters buying.
includes: mandatory return‑pickup OTP or QR code
high return shipping fees or restocking charges
policy stating certain items are non‑returnable after sale
need to retain original tags and packaging
excludes: slow refunds after a successful return
delivery delays unrelated to return process

themes.name: Pre‑Purchase Support Gaps
themes.definition: When shoppers ask about fit, stock, or return terms before buying, they receive slow, vague, scripted, or no responses, leaving doubts unresolved. The lack of timely clarification erodes confidence and halts conversion.
includes: no reply to chat/email query about size availability
generic FAQ answer that does not address specific product
support agent unable to confirm return eligibility for the item
long wait times before any pre‑purchase clarification
excludes: post‑purchase support issues like refund delays
technical app crashes unrelated to support interaction

themes.name: Uncertain Stock & Availability Signals
themes.definition: The system shows an item as in‑stock when wishlisted, then it disappears, shows out‑of‑stock, or gets cancelled without clear alerts, leaving shoppers unsure if they can actually purchase later. This volatility reduces purchase intent.
includes: item marked “available” on wishlist but out of stock at checkout
no notification when saved item goes out of stock
wishlist cap that hides additional saved items
sudden cancellation of order after adding to cart
excludes: stock‑related delivery delays after order placement
general complaints about limited inventory without wishlist context

themes.name: Price Volatility & Hidden Checkout Fees
themes.definition: Shoppers see the price of a saved item rise, promotional discounts disappear, or unexpected fees (platform surcharge, COD penalty, return convenience fee) appear at checkout, making the final cost higher than expected and causing abandonment.
includes: price increase between wishlist add and checkout
promo code removed at final payment step
extra platform service fee disclosed only at checkout
COD surcharge not shown on product page
excludes: overall high price perception unrelated to hidden changes
post‑purchase price adjustments or refunds

themes.name: Uncertain Delivery Timelines
themes.definition: Estimated delivery dates are vague, shift, or extend beyond the shopper’s needed timeframe, and there is no clear information about area coverage or reliability, causing shoppers to defer or cancel the purchase.
includes: delivery estimate shown as “3‑7 days” with no exact date
shipping window that exceeds event date (e.g., wedding)
lack of coverage information for remote pin codes
history of delayed deliveries mentioned in reviews
excludes: late delivery after order has been placed
issues with package tracking after dispatch

themes.name: Wishlist Interface Friction
themes.definition: Getting from a saved item to a purchase takes avoidable mechanical effort — items vanish, scroll position resets, controls are hidden, or the move-to-cart and checkout actions simply do not respond. The added effort and unreliability lead shoppers to give up on saved items.
includes: saved item vanishes after app refresh
no visible “move to cart” button for certain items
scroll position resets when switching tabs
wishlist limit that prevents adding more items
add‑to‑cart button does not respond on saved item page
cannot cancel an order from the wishlist screen
checkout button greyed out with no explanation
error message when tapping ‘move to cart’
excludes: general app crashes unrelated to wishlist
payment gateway errors at checkout

themes.name: Missing Product Specifications
themes.definition: Listings omit the concrete attributes needed to judge suitability — fabric composition, exact garment measurements, care instructions, model height and worn size. Without them the shopper cannot resolve their own question about the saved item, so the decision stalls.
includes: no fabric composition listed on the product page
garment measurements absent (chest, length, sleeve)
no model height or worn-size reference
care or wash instructions missing
stated details contradict each other across the listing
excludes: reviews or buyer photos being absent (see absent-social-proof)
photography that misrepresents the item (see misleading-visual-media)
size charts that exist but are inconsistent (see size-fit-info-unreliable)

themes.name: Absent Social Proof
themes.definition: The saved item carries few or no ratings, written reviews, or photographs from real buyers, so the shopper has no independent corroboration of fit, colour or quality. Lacking anyone else to vouch for it, they postpone rather than commit.
includes: no customer reviews or ratings on the item
reviews exist but none include buyer photographs
shopper explicitly waits for reviews before buying
suspicion that the visible reviews are fake or incentivised
seeking opinions outside the app because the page offers none
excludes: reviews that are present and report quality problems (see quality-authenticity-doubts)
missing seller-supplied specifications (see missing-product-specs)

themes.name: Passive Wishlist, No Re-engagement
themes.definition: The wishlist stores the item and then does nothing: no alert when the price drops, stock runs low, or the size comes back, so the shopper must remember to check manually. Saved items are forgotten rather than rejected, and the intent decays quietly instead of converting.
includes: describes saving an item then forgetting about it entirely
checks the wishlist manually over weeks to catch a sale
wants to be told when a saved item drops in price or restocks
calls the wishlist a bookmark, a dumping ground or 'mark and forget'
misses a sale on something already saved
wishlist has grown so large the shopper no longer revisits it
excludes: the price actually changed unfavourably or fees appeared (price-volatile-hidden-fees)
the item went out of stock or was cancelled (stock-availability-uncertainty)
mechanical failures in the wishlist UI — vanishing items, dead buttons, item caps (wishlist-ui-navigation-friction)
deliberately deciding against a purchase for a stated reason

editNote: Hand-edited after review: split specs from social proof; merged fraud perception into authenticity; merged broken buttons into wishlist interface friction. 17 Aug: added passive-wishlist-no-reengagement as a 12th theme after a hand read of 40 relevant Reddit documents — shoppers repeatedly describe the wishlist as 'mark-and-forget' with nothing bringing them back, which no existing theme covered and which sits closest of all to the 30-day conversion metric.
